serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policewoman: I found what you have written in the papers.
Policewoman: I will ask you some very important questions now, so please answer them truthfully.
Policewoman: Have you spoken about what happened here with anyone? 

You: N-no I don’t think so?
Policewoman: Are you sure? It’s very important.
Ugh! I promised hobo I will not tell them about it, but she’s being very persistent for some reason.
Should I tell her about it?
